name: mfp-flow
description: Live footprint, volume profile and real aggressor delta for MyFundedPerps markets

scripts.ext:build: vite build --config vite.ext.config.ts && esbuild extension/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist-ext/background.js && esbuild extension/content.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist-ext/content.js && cp extension/manifest.json dist-ext/manifest.json
scripts.ext:zip: cd dist-ext && zip -qr ../mfp-flow-extension.zip . && cd .. && ls -la mfp-flow-extension.zip

author: SiS
